severityPolicy.P0: Data loss, secret disclosure, sandbox escape, arbitrary unauthorized execution, or product-wide outage.
severityPolicy.P1: A primary daily workflow is unusable, isolation or rollback is materially weakened, or no safe workaround exists.
severityPolicy.P2: Material defect with a safe workaround or an explicitly accepted bounded residual risk.
severityPolicy.P3: Minor defect without meaningful safety, data-integrity, or daily-workflow impact.

defects.title: Sandbox execution image HIGH/CRITICAL vulnerability gate remediated
Read-only SQL enforced by transactions and connection configuration
In-flight save and workspace changes preserve editor drafts
Fresh core built before integration checks
Navigation check follows extracted language catalog
Local core and UI synchronized with verified backups
Web client no longer offers an unavailable desktop picker
Flow scheduler persisted no wait reason, leaving nodes waiting without a visible cause
Cascade cancellation write was ignored, so a late Cursor completion could revive a cancelled execution
Token usage record insert failure was swallowed and statistics drifted silently
Master turn terminal state was written without checking the error while the client already saw done
Cancellation message stored local time instead of UTC and fell out of conversation order
Handoff and SSH output were cut on byte boundaries, producing invalid UTF-8 for Cyrillic text
Master envelope decoder scanned braces inside the reasoning block and rejected valid answers
Work contract path normalisation stripped leading dots, conflating .env with env
Core failure explanations diverged between the extension banner and the run feed
Work order execution view fell back to a non-escaping identity function for untrusted core text
Manual browser smoke for master session controls no longer passes: the conversation actions panel does not reveal the title input
defects.rationale: Закрыт 19 сентября. Причина была в самой проверке: она вставляла исходник `master-session-ui.js` обычным <script>, вырезав экспорты. Когда в модуле появился `import`, вставка перестала исполняться целиком, обработчик кликов не навешивался и панель не открывалась. Модуль теперь собирается esbuild'ом, а стенд повторяет вызов продукта. Остаётся ручной: требует Edge и Playwright из локальной сборки Code-OSS.

defects.title: Companion stream progress threw ReferenceError: patchCompanionThinkingLabel / patchCompanionStreamingBubble moved into companion-thread-views.js while their call sites stayed in main.js
defects.rationale: Каждое событие потока роняло разбор сообщения: человек видел застывшее «Думает…» без секунд, а ответ появлялся целиком в конце. Оба имени возвращены наружу; свободные переменные теперь ловит scripts/check-webview-exports.mjs.
